archiveDescription: Archiving retires this plan. No new version can be created or published, and it can no longer be assigned. Existing subscriptions keep working on their terms.
changeReasonPlaceholder: What changed in this version, and why?
compareNoChangesDescription: These two versions have identical price, limits, features, AI, and MCP settings.
compareSelectPrompt: Pick two versions to compare their price, limits, features, AI, and MCP settings field by field.
createDescription: A new plan starts as a draft with version 1. It becomes available to subscribers only when a version is published.
description: Create and manage versioned plans. Editing a plan's price or limits always creates a new version — existing subscriptions keep their terms.
duplicateDescription: Copy this plan's current version into a new draft plan. No subscriptions move.
featuresHint: One feature per line. Features are shown on the plan and in comparisons.
mcpPerHourUnlimitedHint: Unlimited here means the platform default applies.
mcpPerMinuteUnlimitedHint: Unlimited here means the platform default applies.
newVersionDescription: A new draft version. The published version and every subscription on it stay untouched until you publish this one.
noPlansDescription: Try a different search or clear the filters.
noPlansEmptyDescription: Create your first plan to start selling. The default Free plan is created automatically when a user needs it.
priceHint: Price in the plan currency (for example 19.99). Leave empty for a free plan.
privateDescription: Private plans are not listed publicly.
publishDescription: Publishing makes this version the plan's current version for new subscribers and supersedes the previously published one. Existing subscriptions keep their effective version.
publishReasonPlaceholder: Why is this version being published?
searchPlaceholder: Search plans by name or slug
slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
title: Plans
trialDaysHint: Days of free trial included with the plan (0 = none).
